record.oneLiner: Google's NotebookLM Enterprise (Gemini Notebook for business) with a v1alpha Discovery Engine REST API for managing notebooks.
record.verdictReason: The API covers notebook management only (create, retrieve, list recently viewed, delete, share) and calls use a gcloud user access token. Access requires an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license plus the Cloud NotebookLM User role. No official Google MCP server was found; community MCP packages exist but are not Google-published.

evidence.quote: gcloud auth print-access-token generates an access token for your user account.
require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.
